title: Curious Urgency 50
author: bpatrick
body: Instead of doing what I was supposed to today I made this. I don’t know, I feel pretty good about it.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: Actually, my last day was yesterday. I have a semester left but I’ll probably never finish. I start med school next month.

comments.author: D
comments.text: Med school? Wow, congrats to that! Anyway, I think it’s been a while since the last ‘Manns search for Meenie’, if I may be so frank. Huge fan here …!

comments.author: K
comments.text: love curious urgency, the last several have been both funny and dramatic, i think there’s a really nice balance here, nice job!

comments.author: AJ
comments.text: I second D whilst i do love curious urgency i would enjoy more MSFM

comments.author: steve
comments.text: I’m happy for you starting med school but afraid of what that will mean for your comics

comments.author: Erick
comments.text: Grats on medschool dude. Curious just keeps getting better.

comments.author: Ed Dale
comments.text: congrats on med school! Not looking forward to the hiatus in comics. Loving Curious Urgency, just went back through and reread all of them. Amazed at how you have kept continuity through each comic.
